name: code_search
description: Unified code search across nine operations - text_search (full-text), object_references (metadata FQN refs), method_references (refs to a specific method), resolve_symbol (go-to-definition), call_hierarchy (incoming / outgoing call tree), symbol_info (type / hover at a code position), content_assist (completion proposals at a position), outgoing_structures (a metadata object's outbound references), help (topic-driven). Pass operation=<name> (snake_case canonical; camelCase like textSearch is also accepted); remaining parameters follow the per-operation contracts. The standalone tools (search_in_code, find_references, go_to_definition, get_method_call_hierarchy, get_symbol_info, get_content_assist, get_outgoing_structures) remain available for backward compat.

operation.description: Operation: text_search / object_references / method_references / resolve_symbol / call_hierarchy / symbol_info / content_assist / outgoing_structures / help (snake_case canonical; camelCase like textSearch is also accepted). operation=help topic=<operation> answers what that one takes.

topic.description: Help topic when operation=help: workflow or the name of an operation. Without it, every operation with a one-line summary.

find.description: With help: search this help for a case-insensitive substring - all the words must appear inside one chunk, and with topic only that topic is searched.

objectName.description: FQN of the metadata object for object_references and outgoing_structures.

filePath.description: BSL file (src/-relative path) for symbol_info / content_assist - the position whose type / completions you want.

positions.description: symbol_info: several positions in the same module, answered in one call and reported in the order given. Each is "line:column" or {"line":N,"column":M}.

contains.description: content_assist: keep only proposals whose name contains this substring.

offset.description: content_assist: skip this many proposals (paging, with limit).

computeTypes.description: symbol_info: resolve the module's cross-references first so the answer names the type of the symbol (default true).

extendedDocumentation.description: content_assist: include the full doc string for each proposal. Default: false.

modulePath.description: call_hierarchy: the module the method lives in - a path from src/ (CommonModules/MyModule/Module.bsl) or a module FQN (CommonModule.MyModule / Catalog.Products.ManagerModule).

direction.description: call_hierarchy direction: incoming / callers (default - who calls this method) or outgoing / callees (what this method calls).

limit.description: Maximum results. text_search: default 100 / max 500. object_references: default 100 / max 500. content_assist: caps the proposal list.

caseSensitive.description: text_search / method_references case sensitivity. Default: false.

isRegex.description: Treat query as regex. Default: false.

compact.description: Trim large text_search responses to first N matches plus stats and top-5 files by match count.

timeoutSeconds.description: Soft scan budget for text_search / method_references (default 25, range 5-120).

fileMask.description: text_search / method_references: filter by module path substring (e.g. 'CommonModules' or 'Documents/SalesOrder').

metadataType.description: text_search: filter by metadata type (commonModules, documents, catalogs, informationRegisters, ...).

outputMode.description: text_search: full (matches with context, default) / count (only the total) / files (file list with match counts, no context).

contextLines.description: text_search: lines of context shown around each match (default 2, max 5).

linesBefore.description: text_search: context lines before each match (overrides contextLines).

linesAfter.description: text_search: context lines after each match (overrides contextLines).

skipBsl.description: object_references: skip the BSL code search phase (metadata-only refs).

bslOnly.description: object_references: search BSL code only, skip metadata back-references. Inverse of skipBsl.

categories.description: object_references: comma-separated whitelist - back (direct back refs) / produced (produced types) / predefined / fields (attribute/dimension refs) / bsl (BSL code).

deep.description: object_references: expand produced types, labelling each by kind (Object / Reference / Selection / Manager / Cache / List).

runKey.description: object_references: resume a Pending search issued earlier. find_references on a large object can exceed the soft timeout and return a runKey - re-call with it to fetch the final result.

includeSource.description: resolve_symbol: include the resolved method's source code (default true).
